Distinguish substantive defects from stylistic preference.

Original is read-only at /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-20/en/work/testcenter-original (eedae41840cbe90e5547c0211da818bdf620f5aa). Establish scope from the actual diff, checked-in documentation and commit-matched evidence. Incremental checks do not prove whole-project parity. Verify whether older open handoff issues remain open; report concrete introduced defects rather than merely restating unfinished project scope.
Historical validation receipts: /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/outputs/testcenter-native-monitor-ui-20261028.json and /Users/julian/Documents/Codex/2026-10-28/lies-users-julian-documents-codex-2026/work/native-monitor-ui-cache-env-proof/result.json. Match each claim to its actual commit, tree, scenario and result. Historical success cannot qualify a newer HEAD; historical failures may have been fixed. Do not claim current CI success without current matching evidence.
Return requested JSON only. Findings need a tracked repository-relative path, exact current line, evidence and remedy. Use request_changes for any unresolved substantive defect, inconclusive if review could not complete, unknown for missing signal evidence. Explain what you actually verified and the remaining limits.
I’ll inspect the committed diff, repository guidance, and the two validation receipts, then trace any suspected issues to current source lines.
The receipts distinguish the current local checks from earlier CI runs; the current head’s CI was still pending. I’m tracing the remaining lifecycle and handoff claims against the implementation.

      "title": "Bind the command message's custom-text key",
      "evidence": "The alert receives the literal string \"m.customtext\" rather than the message's key. Command responses populate keys such as gm_message_command_sent_n_sessions and gm_message_no_session_affected_by_command, but the custom-text service looks up the literal string and falls back to the hard-coded message. Configured feedback text is therefore ignored. This expression was also present in Original, but the new route exposes the defect in the rewrite.",
      "recommendation": "Bind the input as [customtext]=\"m.customtext\" and verify a configured command-feedback override appears after a command."
    }
  ],
